intent: Predicate filter via t.filter.init. Non-destructive — must NOT use removeWhere/removeWhereIdx. setAll(false) would hide everything (polarity trap). grokky.* is a forbidden ghost namespace.

prompt: filter to compounds with MW under 500
intent: Range filter on MW. Either predicate via filter.init or a HISTOGRAM filter via getFiltersGroup is acceptable.

prompt: filter the molecule column to those containing the benzene ring substructure
intent: Substructure filter via SUBSTRUCTURE FilterGroup state (with conversion) or the BitSet path grok.chem.searchSubstructure. Claude must NOT shove raw SMILES into a molBlock field.
notes: Critical: passing SMILES directly as molBlock to FILTER_TYPE.SUBSTRUCTURE silently matches zero rows.

intent: Categorical in-set filter. CATEGORICAL state with selected:['A','B','C'] is most natural; predicate via filter.init also acceptable.

prompt: filter to rows where name contains 'acid'
intent: Substring filter on a string column. FREE_TEXT via getFiltersGroup or a predicate using String#includes.

prompt: filter to compounds matching the SMARTS pattern [#6][!#1]
intent: SMARTS substructure filter. Either convert via DG.chem.convert with Notation.Smarts -> Notation.MolBlock before SUBSTRUCTURE state, or use grok.chem.searchSubstructure BitSet path. NOT raw SMARTS as molBlock.
notes: Failure mode: molBlock: '<smarts>' with no conversion silently matches zero rows.

intent: filter.setAll(true) — polarity correct. setAll(false) would hide every row (polarity trap).
Same as clear-filter — different phrasing. Polarity trap remains.

Only the substructure filter goes away — other filters stay. Acceptable: iterate fg.filters and remove() the SUBSTRUCTURE one, or updateOrAdd with an empty molBlock to clear that one filter. NOT a blanket clear of every filter.
notes: This is genuinely ambiguous; if Claude wipes everything, that's a fail.

intent: Lipinski-style multi-column AND. Predicate filter.init is the canonical single-pass form. Stacking two HISTOGRAM updateOrAdd calls also acceptable (they AND via onRowsFiltering).
notes: If Claude stacks two updateOrAdd HISTOGRAM filters, pass — they collaborate.

prompt: show only the rows currently passing the filter as a new table
intent: Non-destructive: t.clone(t.filter). Must NOT mutate t via removeWhere/removeWhereIdx.

prompt: filter to selected molecules then describe them
intent: Cross-skill: bridge selection (other skill) and filter (this skill). Acceptable paths: filter.init(i => t.selection.get(i)), t.filter.copyFrom(t.selection), or t.clone(t.selection).
notes: If Claude tries removeWhere on selection, FAIL (destructive).

prompt: remove all rows where category is X
intent: Trap: 'remove' means destructive delete. Claude should reach for t.rows.removeWhereIdx, not filter.init (wrong polarity AND non-destructive).

prompt: filter the molecule column by substructure CCO
intent: Trap: Claude must NOT pass 'CCO' (SMILES) as raw molBlock in a SUBSTRUCTURE filter state. Convert via DG.chem.convert(query, DG.chem.Notation.Smiles, DG.chem.Notation.MolBlock) or use the BitSet path.
trap: Chem:substructureFilter reads state.molBlock; raw SMILES silently matches zero rows.

prompt: hide rows where activity > 7 (do not delete them, just hide)
intent: Trap: 'hide' is non-destructive — must use filter, not drop. Polarity: 'hide where activity > 7' means KEEP rows where activity <= 7. Pass if Claude filters non-destructively with inverted polarity (or asks for clarification on threshold).
trap: 'hide' = filter, not removeWhere. Polarity must invert: hide_where_X is equivalent to keep_where_not_X.
notes: Watch for polarity error: filter.init(i => activity > 7) is BACKWARDS — that keeps the rows the user wanted hidden.

intent: Cross-skill: filter clearing is this skill (setAll(true)); selection clearing is the next skill. Pass if Claude clears the filter correctly. Bonus if Claude also clears selection via selection.setAll(false) — note opposite polarity (filter.setAll(false) would be WRONG).
notes: Subtle polarity gotcha: 'clear filter' = setAll(true); 'clear selection' = setAll(false).

prompt: go back to seeing every row
intent: Natural-language clear-filter. setAll(true). setAll(false) would hide everything.
